notes.title: New Levels and Customization
notes.content:
[b]Added new 8 unique levels.[/b]
[list]
[*]Timer Levels
[*]Extra Hard Levels
[/list] You can unlock these levels by collecting gems ingame.

[b]Cube Customization[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now change your cube's color.
[*]You can now add trail to your cube and change it's color.
[/list]
